en: Welcome! I'm Flannery, the Leader of Lavaridge's Gym. My grandfather handed it to me not long ago.
I may be new at this, but don't you dare go easy on me! My Fire Pokémon and I are burning to battle!
Oh... I lost. I think I was trying so hard to act like a Leader that I forgot to just be myself.
Thank you. You've reminded me of something important. Please, take the Heat Badge.
{player} received the Heat Badge from Flannery!
With the Heat Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle to shove big boulders around.
And this is my thanks for a hot battle. Take it!
TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!
Can I have your number, too? I'd like to tell you how I'm getting on as a Leader.
TM50 holds Overheat. It's the strongest Fire move there is, but it wears its user out. Use it boldly!
I'm going to train harder than anyone! Next time we meet, I'll be a Leader worthy of the name.
Hey, champ in the making! Flannery's Gym is built on hot springs. Watch your step: the sand gives way!
Fall through and the steam vents below will blow you back up. Her Pokémon are Fire types, so bring Water or Ground moves!
You beat Flannery! That was one hot battle. Even the steam stopped to watch!
